settings.heading: Made to Order
settings.intro: Every EDS WoodWorx piece is made after you order it. Here’s what that means, how long it takes, and what to expect.

settings.heading: What “made to order” means
settings.text: When you place an order, Ed selects the wood and makes your piece by hand: turning or cutting, shaping, sanding, finishing, and a final check. Nothing comes from a warehouse shelf. Your piece is made for you.

settings.heading: Why it takes a little longer
settings.text: Mass-produced goods are made ahead and stored. Handwork happens one piece at a time, and some steps can’t be rushed, like letting a finish dry properly before a piece is packed. The wait is part of getting something made with care.

settings.heading: Choose → Crafted → Shipped
settings.text: Three steps from your order to your door.

settings.title: Choose
settings.text: Pick your piece and any options. You’ll get an order confirmation email right away.

settings.title: Crafted
settings.text: Ed makes your piece in the workshop. Engraved or personalized pieces take a little longer.

settings.title: Shipped
settings.text: Ed packs it carefully and ships it. You’ll get an email with tracking when it leaves the shop.

settings.heading: Order and shipping updates
settings.text: You’ll receive an email when you order and another when your piece ships, with a tracking link. If anything affects your timing, Ed will email you directly. You can also contact Ed anytime with your order number.

settings.heading: Every piece is a little different
settings.text: Real wood varies. The grain, color, and figure of your piece will differ from the photos, and that’s what makes it yours. Product photos show the style, shape, and finish you can expect.
